DesignCount.method: Count distinct design names after strict three-chunk merge.

InterpDesignCount.method: Count designs whose frozen manifest regime is interp.

ExtrapDesignCount.method: Count designs whose frozen manifest regime is extrap.

SamplesPerDesign.method: Assert the common n field in every manifest policy/design group.

FamilyCount.method: Count family prefixes in the frozen design set.

InterpSftPenalized.method: Mean over designs of sum(count * real post-route Fmax) / n; all unrepresented incorrect samples and implementation failures score zero.

InterpSftConditional.method: Count-weighted real post-route Fmax divided by oracle-correct sample count; implementation failures remain zero.

InterpSftCorrectness.method: Oracle-correct sample multiplicity divided by total original samples.

InterpGain.method: Mean paired per-design difference in penalized equal-sample Fmax.

InterpRelativeGain.method: Relative change of aggregate penalized Fmax: 100 * (GRPO / SFT - 1).

InterpImproved.method: Count designs with strictly positive paired penalized-Fmax difference.

InterpDeclined.method: Count designs with strictly negative paired penalized-Fmax difference.
